728-4681-5170-8292.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2645-3990-5640.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce mana.
Incubation Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3990-5640.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Incubation Druid.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Incubation Druid.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Incubation Druid.
Holding priority, activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of a color a land you control can produce
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Incubation Druid.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of a color a land you control can produce
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3717-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
3717-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Joiner has a +1/+1 counter on it and power 3 or greater.

529-1849-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-6594-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6594-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-4716-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4716-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

323-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

140-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-5686.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

856-2511-2558-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2511-2558-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2034-2198-4613-4679--128.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
2034-2198-4613-4679--128.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
2034-2198-4613-4679--128.description:
Activate Deceiver Exarch using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Deceiver Exarch to Yenna and causing Deceiver Exarch to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3698-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter and Munitions tokens enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers twice and Sword of the Meek triggers from the Thopter entering.
Resolve both Grinding Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-3698-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Grinding Station to deal infinite damage to any target(s). Do this after step 7 but before step 8.

803-4050-4394-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2079-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1140-1636-3143-6170.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6170.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Khalni Heart Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Khalni Heart Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

526-2232-4050-5415.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
526-2232-4050-5415.description:
Cast Vexing Devil by paying {R}.
When Vexing Devil enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating a copy of any nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Vexing Devil to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Vexing Devil trigger from sttep 2, doing nothing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

876-2043-2585-4365.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Grim Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Grim Monolith token.
Activate the Grim Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Grim Monolith token.
Repeat from step 2.

419-2034-4424-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
419-2034-4424-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Missy trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Ixidor by paying {2}{U}, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.

774-2137-2528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
774-2137-2528.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other instant and/or sorcery spell on the stack to get infinite copies of them.

3957-4410.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
3957-4410.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

851-1455-2523-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Adrix and Nev.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating eight copies of Adrix and Nev.
Put all but one legendary Adrix and Nev into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Adrix and Nevs die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

1283-1409-2905.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Pestermite by paying {2}, blinking it.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pestermite.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1117-2178-3689-4497.notablePrerequisites:
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Slobad.
1117-2178-3689-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Workshop Assistant dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
Junk Diver dies, triggering itself and Slobad.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Slobad trigger, untapping it.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.

238-2533-5256.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
238-2533-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gerrard.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gerrard's power.
Repeat.

2076-2279-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Quintorius and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Hazoret's Monument trigger, allowing you to rummage.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

195-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three colors among permanents you control, one of which must be blue.
195-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}{G}.
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, untapping Bloom Tender and choosing to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, targeting Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}{G}.
Resolve the copy of Chain Stasis, untapping Bloom Tender and choosing to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, targeting Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 3.
If there are at least four colors among permanents you control, this combo produces infinite mana.

728-2452-2577.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
